title: WHICH CULTURAL LENS DO MODELS ADOPT? ON CULTURAL POSITIONING BIAS AND AGENTIC MITIGATION IN LLMS
reasoning: The paper investigates cultural positioning bias by evaluating LLMs on their treatment of 10 diverse cultures. The evaluation metrics and qualitative analyses include identifying culturally salient words related to religious and spiritual traditions—such as 'confucianism', 'prophet', 'piety', 'orthodox', and 'rite'—and discusses how models reflect specific cultural values, epistemologies, and societal backgrounds.
